lines.en: label chapthree1:
$ chapthreeactive = True
Or at least nothing of {i}value{/i} here.
lines.zh: 或者说,至少这里没有任何有{i}价值{/i}的东西。

lines.en: The center of the rooftop is missing perhaps the most important piece of the puzzle there is.
lines.zh: 天台的正中央,少掉的或许是这整幅拼图里最重要的一块。

lines.en: And in the space she normally occupies, there is nothing but the memory of her expressionless face and the fading recollection of the way her eyes would catch and reflect the light.
lines.zh: 而在她平时站着的那个位置上,只剩下对她那张面无表情的脸的记忆,以及她的眼睛捕捉并反射光线时那副样子正在淡去的回想。

lines.en: I can’t tell her.
lines.zh: 我没法告诉她。

lines.en: I can’t tell her anything if she is not here.
lines.zh: 她不在这里,我什么都没法告诉她。

lines.en: I can’t.
lines.zh: 我做不到。

lines.en: I can’t tell her anything if she is not here.
lines.zh: 她不在这里,我什么都没法告诉她。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei...

lines.en: There is nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没有。

lines.en: No picnic. No scarf. No unenthusiastic welcome or the subtle realization and subsequent acceptance that things are going to be “okay.”
lines.zh: 没有野餐。没有围巾。没有那副无精打采的迎接,也没有「事情会好起来的」这种微妙的领悟与随之而来的接受。

lines.en: Because they’re not.
lines.zh: 因为事情不会好起来。

lines.en: Things are {i}not{/i} going to be okay.
lines.zh: 事情{i}不{/i}会好起来了。

lines.en: How {i}could{/i} they be?
lines.zh: 又怎么{i}可能{/i}好起来?

lines.en: I still don’t understand what’s supposed to happen next.
lines.zh: 我依然不明白接下来该发生什么。

lines.en: And I’m even more confused about what is going to happen to {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 而{i}她{/i}身上会发生什么,我更加摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei...

lines.en: : I don’t see her...
lines.zh: : 我没看到她...

lines.en: You don’t see her because she’s not there.
lines.zh: 你没看到她,是因为她不在那里。

lines.en: You don’t see her because she’s already gone.
lines.zh: 你没看到她,是因为她已经走了。

lines.en: You don’t see her because the two of {i}us,{/i} the ones without hundreds or thousands or millions of years of experience are the ones who managed to make it here in her place.
lines.zh: 你没看到她,是因为{i}我们{/i}两个——没有几百年、几千年、几百万年经验的我们——反倒代替她来到了这里。

lines.en: And that she likely vanished or disintegrated or melted or whatever the fuck happens to those of us who aren’t fortunate enough to stand beneath these stars.
lines.zh: 而她大概已经消失、分解、融化,或者随便什么他妈的会发生在我们这些没福气站在这些星空下的人身上的事。

lines.en: That’s right...
lines.zh: 对了……

lines.en: The stars.
lines.zh: 星星。

lines.en: She can’t see them anymore.
lines.zh: 她再也看不到它们了。

lines.en: And I still can’t figure out what it is about them that made her fall in love.
lines.zh: 而我还是搞不懂,它们身上到底有什么让她爱上了它们。

lines.en: I can’t do anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都做不了。

lines.en: I can’t do anything.
lines.zh: 我什么都做不了。

lines.en: I can’t.
lines.zh: 我做不到。

lines.en: I can’t if she’s not here.
lines.zh: 她不在这里,我就做不到。

lines.en: : Sensei...please say something. This is already weird enough for me and...having you silent is only making me feel worse.
lines.zh: : Sensei...说点什么吧。这对我来说已经够诡异了,而你一言不发只会让我更难受。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya1
: This hasn’t ever happened before.
lines.zh: : 这种事以前从没发生过。

lines.en: : What hasn’t happened before? Maya not being here?
lines.zh: : 什么以前从没发生过?Maya 不在这里?

lines.en: : Well...maybe she’s just running late?
lines.zh: : 呃……也许她只是迟到了?

lines.en: : How long were you here before you found me, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你在找到我之前,在这里待了多久,Ayane?

lines.en: : I...can’t really remember...
lines.zh: : 我……真的记不清了……

lines.en: : It all happened so quickly that I wasn’t really keeping track of time...
lines.zh: : 一切都发生得太快,我根本没在留意时间……

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya2
: Well...uhh...at least we have each other! Right?
lines.zh: : 那个……呃……至少我们还有彼此!对吧?

lines.en: : And if the world does wind up doing that...reset thingy, then you and me will go back to the start and...and we can just remind Maya of all the stuff she’s missed!
lines.zh: : 而且如果世界最后真的搞了那个……重置什么的,那我和你会回到起点,然后……然后我们只要把 Maya 错过的那些事都提醒她就好啦!

lines.en: : It doesn’t work that way, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 事情不是那样的,Ayane。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya3
: I’m sorry, but I still don’t know how any of this is supposed to work...
lines.zh: : 抱歉,但我还是不明白这一切到底是怎么运作的……

lines.en: : And without Maya here to clue me in on all of that stuff like you said, the only person who can tell me {i}anything{/i} is you.
lines.zh: : 而 Maya 不在这里,没法像你说的那样给我讲清楚这些事,唯一能告诉我点{i}什么{/i}的人就只有你了。

lines.en: : So tell me...
lines.zh: : 所以告诉我吧……

lines.en: : Help me understand what happens next. Help me understand how we can...start over and...bring everyone back.
lines.zh: : 让我搞懂接下来会发生什么。让我搞懂我们要怎么……重新开始,怎么……把所有人带回来。

lines.en: : Maya included.
lines.zh: : 包括 Maya。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei...

lines.en: : I don’t know if the Maya you know will {i}ever{/i} come back.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你认识的那个 Maya {i}还会不会{/i}回来。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya4
: What?...But you said-
lines.zh: : 什么?……可你说过——

lines.en: : Everyone starts over. Which they do.
lines.zh: : 每个人都会重新开始。这一点没错。

lines.en: : But Maya was doing this for so long that she stopped keeping track of time.
lines.zh: : 但 Maya 做这件事做了太久,久到她早就不再计算时间了。

lines.en: : She came to this roof under this sky over and over again and had to put up with me more than any one person should ever have to.
lines.zh: : 她一遍又一遍地来到这片天空下的这个天台,还不得不忍受我——比任何一个人所该忍受的都要多。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how long she must have been doing this for, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你知道她这样做了多久吗,Ayane?

lines.en: : I don’t...but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道……可是——

lines.en: : Do you think that clearing millions of years worth of memories out of her would result in her being the same person we know today?
lines.zh: : 你觉得把几百万年份的记忆从她脑子里清空之后,她还会是我们今天认识的那个人吗?

lines.en: : What about thousands?
lines.zh: : 几千年呢?

lines.en: : Hundreds?
lines.zh: : 几百年呢?

lines.en: : Even {i}ten{/i} years worth of experiencing this would turn a person into someone else.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是经历{i}十{/i}年的这种事,也足以把一个人变成另一个人。

lines.en: : If she doesn’t do this with us, we’ll never see {i}her{/i} again.
lines.zh: : 如果她不跟我们一起做这件事,我们就再也见不到{i}她{/i}了。

lines.en: : Sure, there might be someone in her body. But it won’t be {i}Maya.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然,她的身体里可能还会有某个人在。但那不会是 {i}Maya{/i}。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya5
: Has she...really been doing this for that long?...
lines.zh: : 她……真的做了那么久吗?……

lines.en: : How come she never said anything?
lines.zh: : 那她为什么从来没说过?

lines.en: : I’m sure she tried. But she can’t even {i}talk{/i} about the past to me without risking my brain malfunctioning.
lines.zh: : 我相信她试过。可她哪怕只是跟我{i}谈{/i}起过去,都有让我的大脑出故障的风险。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya6
: But...But I talk about the past all the time and you’ve never once {i}malfunctioned{/i} around me!
lines.zh: : 可是……可是我也一直在讲过去的事啊,你在我身边一次都没{i}出过故障{/i}!

lines.en: : How come I can do it but she can’t? That doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 为什么我能讲她就讲不了?这完全说不通。

lines.en: : Does any of this make sense?
lines.zh: : 这整件事有哪一点说得通吗?

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya7

: Not long ago, I was in the same position you’re in right now. And even though my memory is shit compared to what you want it to be, I can still faintly recall how confused I must have been back then.
lines.zh: : 不久之前,我也处在你现在的位置上。虽然我的记忆跟你期望的比起来烂透了,但我还是能隐约想起当时的自己有多么困惑。

lines.en: : But unlike Maya, I’m not ready or even {i}capable{/i} of filling in all of the blanks because I’ve yet to find anything to actually fill them in {i}with.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但和 Maya 不同,我既没准备好,也没那个{i}本事{/i}去把所有空白填满,因为我至今还没找到任何能{i}填进去{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : I’m only a little less lost than you are, Ayane. But that doesn’t mean I have any idea where to go from here.
lines.zh: : 我只是比你稍微不那么迷失一点而已,Ayane。但这不代表我知道接下来该往哪走。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya8
: One of the worst parts of this, though...is that I’m pretty sure she tried warning me.
lines.zh: : 不过这件事最糟的地方之一……是我很确定她试过警告我。

lines.en: : But I just shrugged it off like it was another one of her patented spiritual monologues and pretended that sort of thing wouldn’t ever happen.
lines.zh: : 可我只是把它当成她又一段招牌式的灵性独白,耸耸肩就放过了,还装作那种事永远不会发生。

lines.en: : I always figured the chances of {i}me{/i} not making it back here were higher than the chances of her, the girl who’s done it for longer than she can even remember, were.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为,回不来的那个人更可能是{i}我{/i},而不是她——那个做得久到自己都记不清有多久的女孩。

lines.en: : Sensei...I know you’re...scared and hurt and...probably worried about what’s going to happen to Maya...
lines.zh: : Sensei……我知道你……害怕、受伤,而且……大概还在担心 Maya 会怎么样……

lines.en: : But please remember that this is just as scary for me...
lines.zh: : 但请记住,对我而言这也一样可怕……

lines.en: : And that even if you don’t know as much as Maya does about what’s happening...
lines.zh: : 而且就算你对正在发生的事知道得没有 Maya 那么多……

lines.en: : That I could really use the comfort right now...
lines.zh: : 我现在也真的很需要一点安慰……

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya9
: It’s my first “end of the world” after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟这是我第一次「世界末日」。

lines.en: : Well...I guess you said it was technically my second. But I don’t have any memories of the first one, so...I guess I’m kind of an apocalypse virgin by proxy.
lines.zh: : 呃……按你的说法,严格来讲这算是我的第二次。可我对第一次一点记忆都没有,所以……我大概算是个「代理版」的末日处女吧。

lines.en: scene black
She’s right.
lines.zh: 她是对的。

lines.en: The absence of the girl who knows too much doesn’t mean that the one who knows too little should suffer.
lines.zh: 那个知道得太多的女孩不在了,并不意味着知道得太少的这个就该受苦。

lines.en: And despite my inadequacies in the face of understanding this, I should be...figuring out a way to make Ayane more comfortable instead of wallowing in my own self-doubt.
lines.zh: 尽管在理解这件事上我是那么无能,我也该……想办法让 Ayane 好受一点,而不是沉溺在自己的自我怀疑里。

lines.en: It’s just that the idea of doing that when I’m less comfortable than ever before is intimidating to me.
lines.zh: 只是,要在我自己前所未有的难受时去做这件事,光是想想就让我胆怯。

lines.en: This is {i}all{/i} so intimidating to me.
lines.zh: 这{i}一切{/i}都让我胆怯。

lines.en: And while I’m reluctant to call it codependency because that’s just the type of person I am...could it be anything but?
lines.zh: 虽然我不太愿意把这叫做互相依赖,因为我本来就是那种人……可除了这个还能是什么?

lines.en: For the first time, I experience what it means to miss someone.
lines.zh: 有生以来第一次,我体会到了想念一个人是什么滋味。

lines.en: I wish she was here.
lines.zh: 我希望她在这里。

lines.en: I wish she was here so I could stop taking the incessant warnings for granted and actually take a step forward in hopes of preparing myself for this exact scenario.
lines.zh: 我希望她在这里,这样我就能不再把她那些没完没了的警告当作理所当然,而是真的向前迈出一步,好为眼前这个局面做点准备。

lines.en: I wish she was here so I could see the shock on her face when she thinks I’ve managed to impregnate Ayane {i}again{/i} and I wish to hear the subsequent “You’re disgusting” that would come from that.
lines.zh: 我希望她在这里,这样我就能看到她以为我{i}又{/i}把 Ayane 搞怀孕时脸上的震惊,也能听到随后那句「你真恶心」。

lines.en: But all I hear is the soft, controlled sobbing of another girl who’s gotten too close to me and the faint clopping of our footsteps as we make our way over to a nearby planter.
lines.zh: 但我听到的,只有又一个离我太近的女孩压抑而克制的啜泣,还有我们走向附近花坛时轻微的嗒嗒脚步声。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya10
: I’m sorry, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 对不起,Ayane。

lines.en: : Don’t apologize. You never apologize for anything and it’s making me worried.
lines.zh: : 别道歉。你从来不为任何事道歉的,这让我很担心。

lines.en: : If there’s ever a time to worry, I’m pretty sure this is it.
lines.zh: : 如果真有该担心的时候,我很确定就是现在。

lines.en: : The world could end at any given moment and we’d either just...die or pick up from some unknown point in time and have to live our lives all over again.
lines.zh: : 世界随时都可能终结,而我们要么就这么……死掉,要么从某个未知的时间点重新接上,不得不把人生再活一遍。

lines.en: : I guess there’s not much of a difference in either of those things if we can’t remember anything, though.
lines.zh: : 不过要是我们什么都记不住,这两种结果大概也没什么区别。
: 如果……

lines.en: : If something like that really did happen...and we did have to start our lives all over...
lines.zh: : 如果那种事真的发生了……而我们真的得把人生重新来过……

lines.en: : Do you think there’s anything you’d change?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会改变什么吗?

lines.en: : I think there are things I would want to change.
lines.zh: : 我想,确实有些事是我想要改变的。

lines.en: : But I doubt I’d be able to actually make any of those changes happen.
lines.zh: : 但我怀疑自己真的能让那些改变成真。

lines.en: : I’d probably be the same cynical...immoral...teenager-fucking narcissist I am now.
lines.zh: : 我大概还是现在这个愤世嫉俗的……不道德的……专操女学生的自恋狂。

lines.en: : No god or twist of fate would be able to change that.
lines.zh: : 什么神明、什么命运的转折,都改变不了这一点。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya11
: Assuming you’d still sleep with me, that is. And that you wouldn’t use your new lease on life to make better, more informed, and less impulsive decisions.
lines.zh: : 前提是到时候你还愿意跟我上床。而且你也不会借着这条新命,去做出更好、更明智、不那么冲动的选择。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei...

lines.en: : You are the one decision in my life that I could not possibly regret.
lines.zh: : 你是我这辈子唯一一个绝对不会后悔的决定。

lines.en: : Not in this world or any others.
lines.zh: : 无论是在这个世界,还是其他任何一个世界。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya12
: That doesn’t mean I wouldn’t change {i}anything,{/i} though. There are plenty of regrets I have in my life.
lines.zh: : 不过这并不意味着我{i}什么{/i}都不想改。我这辈子有够多后悔的事。

lines.en: : But if I had to choose {i}one{/i} thing...
lines.zh: : 但如果只能挑{i}一{/i}件……

lines.en: : I’d probably tell my mom I love her more often.
lines.zh: : 我大概会更常跟我妈说我爱她。

lines.en: : Maybe that was all it would have taken to keep her around.
lines.zh: : 也许只要那样,就能把她留下来。

lines.en: : It’s just like you to think of someone who abandoned you at a time like this.
lines.zh: : 你就是这样的人,在这种时候还会去想那个抛弃了你的人。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s that uncommon to think about your parents in what could be your final moments. Even adults cry for their moms sometimes when they’re feeling scared.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在可能是人生最后时刻的时候想起父母,并不算什么稀奇事。就算是大人,害怕的时候有时也会哭着喊妈妈。

lines.en: : Plus, since I’ve already vowed to keep all of my Sensei-based decisions as-is, having her around would certainly take a load off of {i}your{/i} back.
lines.zh: : 再说,既然我已经发誓要把跟你有关的所有决定原样保留,她要是在的话,肯定能替{i}你{/i}分担不少。

lines.en: : Having a caring parent around would put a lot {i}more{/i} strain on my back if you truly intend to keep all of your Sensei-based decisions as-is.
lines.zh: : 可如果你真打算把跟你有关的所有决定原样保留,那有个关心你的家长在,我的腰反倒要承受{i}更{/i}大的压力。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya13
: I guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : But hey! We don’t even know for sure if something like that is going to happen yet.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来!我们还不确定那种事到底会不会发生呢。

lines.en: : For all we know, Maya could show up at any moment and the two of us could welcome her with open arms the same way she’s welcomed you in the past.
lines.zh: : 说不定 Maya 随时就会出现,然后我们俩可以张开双臂欢迎她,就像她过去欢迎你那样。

lines.en: : She’s not coming, Ayane. She’s never been late before.
lines.zh: : 她不会来了,Ayane。她以前从来没有迟到过。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s not late at all?
lines.zh: : 也许她根本没迟到?

lines.en: : Maybe {i}we’re{/i} just early?
lines.zh: : 也许是{i}我们{/i}来早了?

lines.en: : That seems just as unlikely.
lines.zh: : 这听起来同样不太可能。

lines.en: : How come? Cause it hasn’t happened yet in the few times you’ve done this?
lines.zh: : 为什么?就因为你做过的那几次里还没发生过?

lines.en: : That’s not a very big sample size, Sensei. And if you really {i}don’t{/i} know the full details of what’s going on here, can you really say with such conviction that something {i}isn’t{/i} going to happen?
lines.zh: : 那样本量可不算大,Sensei。而且如果你真的{i}不{/i}清楚这里到底是怎么回事,你真能这么笃定地说某件事{i}不{/i}会发生吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know how we got to this point, but I’m pretty sure that I’m the one who’s supposed to be comforting you right now. Not the other way around.
lines.zh: : 我不知道怎么就变成这样了,但我很确定现在该安慰人的是我,而不是反过来。

lines.en: : That’s what I thought at first too.
lines.zh: : 我一开始也是这么想的。

lines.en: : But the longer we sit here...and the longer I stare at that mopey face of yours-
lines.zh: : 可我们在这里坐得越久……我盯着你那张哭丧脸看得越久——

lines.en: : The more I understand how important Maya is to you.
lines.zh: : 我就越明白 Maya 对你有多重要。

lines.en: : And the more I understand how scared you must be right now.
lines.zh: : 也就越明白你现在有多害怕。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya14
: She’s no more important to me than anyone else is.
lines.zh: : 她对我来说并不比别人更重要。

lines.en: : Oh? So you also showed the same level of hesitation every time you’ve come up here to find that everyone {i}other{/i} than Maya was missing?
lines.zh: : 哦?那每次你上来发现除了 Maya {i}之外{/i}所有人都不见了的时候,你也表现出了同样程度的犹豫?

lines.en: : Only after being reassured that you’d all come back and be exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 只有在被保证你们都会回来、而且一模一样之后,才没有。

lines.en: : I guess that’s a fair point. But I still think there’s a side of it that you’re not telling me.
lines.zh: : 这话说得倒也在理。但我还是觉得,有一部分是你没告诉我的。

lines.en: : Which is fine. I’d never ask you to tell me anything you don’t want to, just like I’d never expect you to do the same for me.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我永远不会要求你说不想说的事,就像我也从不指望你为我做到同样的事。

lines.en: : But, so long as you’re going to sit here looking worried, I’m going to sit right beside you and try to make some of those worries go away.
lines.zh: : 不过,只要你还坐在这里一脸愁容,我就会坐在你旁边,试着把那些烦恼赶走一些。

lines.en: : That’s what it means to love someone after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟,爱一个人就是这么回事。

lines.en: : And even now, with the stars crashing down around us, there is nothing I am more sure of than the fact that I’d dive in front of one to save your life.
lines.zh: : 就算是现在,在群星朝我们坠落的时候,我也从未像此刻这样确信——我会冲到其中一颗前面去救你。

lines.en: : We’d both die if a star ever came that close to us.
lines.zh: : 要是星星真靠得那么近,我们俩都会死。

lines.en: : True. But it’s the thought that counts during times like that. And I’m sure your final thoughts of me would be something like, “Wow! Ayane is so cool!”
lines.zh: : 没错。但这种时候,心意才重要。而且我敢肯定,你临终前对我的想法会是「哇!Ayane 好帅!」之类的。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya15
: Or maybe the Arakawa and Amamiya families could combine forces and use both of their secret techniques to take the star down once and for all and save everyone?
lines.zh: : 或者 Arakawa 家和 Amamiya 家可以联手,用上两家的秘传绝技,一劳永逸地把那颗星星打下来,救下所有人?

lines.en: : This certainly would make a good final installment for the Battle of Kumon-mi, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这肯定能成为 Kumon-mi 之战一个相当不错的最终章,不是吗?

lines.en: : If only Todd were here with us.
lines.zh: : 要是 Todd 也在就好了。

lines.en: : Did the reset claim him as well?
lines.zh: : 连他也被重置带走了吗?

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya16
: You know, it’s the craziest thing.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,这事怪得要命。

lines.en: : He just ran out of the dorm the other night faster than I’d ever seen him run before. So fast that even I couldn’t keep up with him.
lines.zh: : 前几天晚上他一头冲出宿舍,跑得比我见过的任何一次都快。快到连我都追不上他。

lines.en: : I have no idea where he went, but I haven’t seen him ever since. And if every other {i}human{/i} is gone, I guess it wouldn’t be crazy for chickens to follow suit.
lines.zh: : 我不知道他跑去了哪儿,从那以后就再没见过他。不过如果其他{i}人类{/i}都没了,鸡跟着一起消失好像也不算离谱。

lines.en: : Also, the more I talk about this, the more I realize how weird reality has become and that we really are just living in a simulation.
lines.zh: : 还有,这件事我越说越觉得,现实已经变得多离谱,而我们真的就活在一个模拟里。

lines.en: : This is a really shitty simulation if that is actually true.
lines.zh: : 如果真是这样,那这模拟可真够烂的。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya17
: Hey, nobody said it had to be a good one.
lines.zh: : 嘿,又没人说它非得是个好的。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, though...simulation or not...
lines.zh: : 不过到头来……不管是不是模拟……

lines.en: : I’m glad I met you.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴遇见了你。

lines.en: : And I’m not just saying that because we could die at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 而且我不只是因为我们随时可能死掉才这么说。

lines.en: : I’m glad I met you too, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴遇见你,Ayane。

lines.en: : It’s unfortunate that you have to deal with this version of me in what could very well be our final moments.
lines.zh: : 只可惜,在很可能是我们最后时刻的时候,你得面对这样一版的我。

lines.en: : If I can’t handle you at your worst, I don’t deserve you at your best.
lines.zh: : 如果我连最糟的你都承受不了,那我就不配拥有最好的你。

lines.en: : Would you care to remind me exactly what my “best” is? Because that’s not really a thing I thought I had.
lines.zh: : 你能提醒一下我的「最好」到底是什么样吗?因为我还真不觉得自己有那种东西。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya18
: Your best is the side of you that is able to frown over the loss of a girl who’s done nothing but insult you and avoid you for as long as I’ve known you two.
lines.zh: : 你最好的一面,就是你会为一个女孩的消失而皱起眉头——而从我认识你们俩开始,她除了侮辱你、躲着你,什么都没做过。

lines.en: : Though...I guess there’s a lot more to it that I just don’t understand yet.
lines.zh: : 不过……我想这里面还有很多是我还不懂的。

lines.en: I was wrong.
lines.zh: 我错了。

lines.en: There is something of value here.
lines.zh: 这里有有价值的东西。

lines.en: It might not be the sort of value that can guarantee my prolonged existence or assist me in unraveling the mysteries of the universe-
lines.zh: 那也许不是能保证我继续存在下去、或帮我解开宇宙之谜的那种价值——

lines.en: But it’s the sort of value that can manage to make me care a little less about those things as our time runs out.
lines.zh: 但那是能在我们的时间耗尽时,让我对那些事情少在意一点的价值。
: 那么……

lines.en: : How long until this actually happens?
lines.zh: : 还有多久才会真的发生?

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya19
: See...that’s the thing.
lines.zh: : 你看……问题就在这儿。

lines.en: : I don’t really know {i}what{/i} happens now that Maya isn’t here.
lines.zh: : 我其实不知道 Maya 不在了之后会发生{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : This is normally the part where she just resets the world and everything jumps backward or...forward. Or in some other direction.
lines.zh: : 平常到了这个环节,她就会把世界重置一下,然后一切向后跳……或者向前跳。或者跳到别的什么方向。

lines.en: : But I have no idea if there’s like, some sort of time limit to this or anything.
lines.zh: : 但我完全不知道这有没有什么时间限制之类的。

lines.en: : Well...how exactly does she reset the world?
lines.zh: : 呃……她到底是怎么重置世界的?

lines.en: : I think she just...prays or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她就是……祈祷什么的。

lines.en: : She’s told me anyone can do it before, but...
lines.zh: : 她跟我说过,任何人都能做到,不过……

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya20
: You can’t bring yourself to try without her here...
lines.zh: : 她不在,你没法说服自己去试……

lines.en: : Is that it?
lines.zh: : 是这样吗?

lines.en: : Something...like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多……是这样。

lines.en: : Well...I’m fine with waiting if you are.
lines.zh: : 呃……如果你愿意等,我也愿意等。

lines.en: : Maya is important to me as well, even if she {i}is{/i} yet another rival in love now. And one with a pretty distinct advantage at that.
lines.zh: : Maya 对我也很重要,哪怕她现在又{i}成了{/i}我的一个情敌,而且还带着相当明显的优势。

lines.en: : I wonder if I’d be far ahead too if I was some sort of supernatural time traveler?
lines.zh: : 我要是也算是某种超自然的时间旅行者,是不是也会领先很多?

lines.en: : Probably. Those are qualities that are hard to overlook in a romantic interest.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。这种特质在恋爱对象身上是很难被忽略的。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya13
: Let me ask you this, then.
lines.zh: : 那我问你这个。

lines.en: : If we really don’t intend to try this resetting thing {i}without{/i} Maya here, which I am in full support of...do we really want to wait for her? Or do we want to be proactive about this instead?
lines.zh: : 如果我们真的不打算在 Maya {i}不在{/i}的时候尝试重置——这点我完全支持——那我们真要干等着她吗?还是说不如主动一点?

lines.en: : Proactive?
lines.zh: : 主动?

lines.en: : Like...what if she’s still out there somewhere?
lines.zh: : 比如……万一她还在外面的某个地方呢?

lines.en: : What if she’s doing what I did and just frantically searching all over the place for signs of life?
lines.zh: : 万一她正像我之前那样,发疯似的到处寻找生命的迹象?

lines.en: : I think she’s experienced this sort of thing enough by now to know that such an effort is futile.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她经历这种事够多了,应该知道那种努力是白费力气。

lines.en: : Then, better question-
lines.zh: : 那么,换个更好的问题——

lines.en: : What if she’s also wandering around in some random location completely naked right now? Like you were minutes before I found you.
lines.zh: : 万一她现在也正一丝不挂地在某个随机的地方到处晃呢?就像我找到你之前几分钟的你那样。

lines.en: : All I’m saying is that, during a time like this, I think it makes sense for {i}anyone{/i} to go a little crazy. Even if it’s something they’ve seen a bunch of times before.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说,在这种时候,{i}任何人{/i}有点发疯都很正常。哪怕这种事他们已经见过很多次了。

lines.en: : Is that a little too optimistic? Probably. But it’s much better to think of crazy, naked Maya than no Maya at all, right?
lines.zh: : 这会不会太乐观了?大概吧。但总比去想「根本没有 Maya」要好得多,对吧?

lines.en: : That...would certainly be a better alternative, yes.
lines.zh: : 那……确实是个更好的可能,没错。

lines.en: : I thought you checked everywhere, though?
lines.zh: : 可我记得你说过你到处都找过了?

lines.en: : Kumon-mi’s a big city, Sensei. There are tons of stones I haven’t turned yet.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 是座大城市,Sensei。还有很多石头我没翻过呢。

lines.en: : The only problem is that, if there {i}is{/i} some sort of time limit for this, we might die before we actually find her.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是,如果这{i}真有{/i}什么时间限制,我们可能还没找到她就先死了。

lines.en: : But at this point, since neither of us want to try going through with this without her, that’s probably going to happen anyway.
lines.zh: : 但事到如今,既然我们俩都不想在没有她的情况下走这一步,那大概横竖都是这个结果。

lines.en: : Plus, if I hadn’t made that announcement over the PA, you might still be running around somewhere with your penis flapping in the wind.
lines.zh: : 再说,要不是我用广播喊了那么一嗓子,你可能还在某个地方到处乱跑,家伙在风里甩来甩去。

lines.en: : I think that sort of method is worth a shot for Maya. We’ve just...gotta figure out where she is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这招对 Maya 值得一试。我们只要……搞清楚她在哪儿就行。

lines.en: scene resetwithoutmaya21
: That’s...
: I mean, it’s not a {i}bad{/i} idea by any means. It’s just-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是,这主意绝对不算{i}差{/i}。只是——

lines.en: : You’re a pessimist, I know.
lines.zh: : 你是个悲观主义者,我知道。

lines.en: : But even if there is 0.01%% chance of this working, I think we have to try.
lines.zh: : 但哪怕只有 0.01%% 的机会,我觉得我们也得试试。

lines.en: : And I think that, if we don’t, we’ll wind up regretting it for the rest of our lives...
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得,如果我们不试,余生都会为此后悔……

lines.en: I guess...there’s not really any {i}harm{/i} in going out and looking for Maya. Especially since she’d just wind up waiting for me after getting here anyway.
lines.zh: 我想……出去找找 Maya 也没什么{i}坏处{/i}。尤其是反正她到了这儿之后,多半也只是等着我就行。

lines.en: But, like Ayane said, Kumon-mi is a huge city...and if Maya is constantly moving around, she could theoretically stay lost forever.
lines.zh: 但就像 Ayane 说的,Kumon-mi 是座巨大的城市……而如果 Maya 一直在移动,理论上她可能永远都找不到。

lines.en: With that in mind, wouldn’t it be best to just wait {i}here?{/i}
lines.zh: 这么一想,难道不是就在{i}这里{/i}等着最好吗?

lines.en: My stomach twists itself in knots as I do my best to fight off what I believe at first to be a wave of nausea, but discern moments later as just a sinking feeling in my gut.
lines.zh: 我的胃绞成一团,我拼命抵抗着一开始以为是恶心感的东西,片刻之后才分辨出来,那只是胃里一种下沉的感觉。

lines.en: A feeling telling me to go along with Ayane’s idea despite its flaws and the fact that it could very well backfire and cause both of us to lose ourselves forever.
lines.zh: 那种感觉在告诉我,要顺着 Ayane 的主意走,尽管它有缺陷,也很可能弄巧成拙,让我们两个永远失去自己。

lines.en: A feeling that I should be discarding in favor of {i}her{/i} safety so that I can ensure at least {i}she{/i} does not have to repeat a life that brought her nothing but pain and perpetual longing.
lines.zh: 那种感觉我本该为了{i}她{/i}的安全而丢掉,好确保至少{i}她{/i}不必再把那充满痛苦与无尽渴望的人生重来一遍。

lines.en: But a feeling that I {i}can’t{/i} discard because it is impossible for me to prioritize the feelings of others over my own.
lines.zh: 但那种感觉我又{i}丢不掉{/i},因为我不可能把别人的感受放在自己的感受之前。

lines.en: It’s only fitting that my organs would start twisting the moment I come to terms with the possibility of acting selfless.
lines.zh: 也算是恰如其分——就在我接受「也许该无私一回」这个可能性的瞬间,我的内脏就开始打结了。

lines.en: And it’s only fitting that I would risk it all once more in an attempt to move one step closer to the embrace of someone who should only be admired from afar.
lines.zh: 也同样恰如其分——我愿意再次赌上一切,只为向那个本该只可远观的人的怀抱再靠近一步。

lines.en: The idea of Maya living on in my memories without retaining her own makes me sick.
lines.zh: 一想到 Maya 会活在我的记忆里,却留不住她自己的记忆,我就觉得恶心。

lines.en: But what makes me even sicker is knowing that she’s been stifling that nausea this whole time.
lines.zh: 但更让我恶心的是,我知道她一直都在压抑着那份恶心。

lines.en: And that each and every warning she gave me must have only made it worse.
lines.zh: 而她给我的每一个警告,一定都只是让那份恶心更重。

lines.en: Before making my decision, a familiar thought crosses my mind.
lines.zh: 在我做出决定之前,一个熟悉的念头掠过脑海。

lines.en: Why does everything have to hurt so much?
lines.zh: 为什么什么都非得这么疼?

lines.en: scene black
On our way down the stairs and into the street, I bite off a large chunk of my nail.
lines.zh: 在下楼走向街道的途中,我咬下了一大块指甲。

lines.en: A great deal of my skin comes off along with it.
lines.zh: 连带着扯下来一大片皮。

lines.en: And while I roll it across my teeth and press against the sharpest bit of it with my tongue, I am reminded once more of why everything has to hurt so much.
lines.zh: 我把它在齿间滚来滚去,用舌尖顶住最尖的那一处,于是又一次被提醒了,为什么什么都非得这么疼。

lines.en: It is not because we want it to.
lines.zh: 不是因为我们想要疼。

lines.en: It is because we deserve it.
lines.zh: 是因为我们活该。
